property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when the call does not revert.
The transfer function must revert if any token transfer fails, ensuring all recipients receive the exact amount.
The transfer function always returns true if it completes successfully (does not revert).
The function must revert if the first element of _tos is the zero address when making a transfer, because calling transferFrom on the zero address should fail.
The transfer function reverts if any call to caddress fails (e.g., when _tos includes the zero address, which causes transferFrom to revert).
The function transfer returns true if and only if all internal calls succeed
For any valid input, calling transfer should succeed (not revert) when _tos array has at least one element.
After a successful transfer call, the return value should be true (the function must not revert when _tos array has at least one element).
Calling transfer with a non-empty _tos array always returns true.
Calling transfer from a non-zero address to a non-zero contract address with a non-empty _tos array and a non-zero value should not revert.
The transfer function must iterate over all elements of the input array _tos.
transfer should call transferFrom on the caddress for every address in _tos
transfer should revert if any recipient address in _tos is the zero address
transfer returns true and does not revert when _tos length is 1
After a successful call to transfer, the number of times caddress was called equals the length of _tos.
transfer calls transferFrom on the caddress for each address in _tos, including the last one.
